_comment: Restores the Cobblemon worldgen features that silently never generated in this pack.
Cobblemon injects its features in CODE (data/cobblemon/forge/biome_modifier/coded.json is
just 'cobblemon:inject_coded'), and CobblemonPlacedFeatures gates each one on a biome tag.
Most pass null - every biome - which is why apricorn trees, saccharine trees, mints and
medicinal leek all work here. But berry groves and big root are gated on
minecraft:is_overworld, and TerraFirmaGreg's 109 overworld biomes are deliberately NOT in
that tag: keeping them out is what stops every other mod's overworld worldgen leaking into
the pack. The result was that not one berry generated anywhere in the world.
Adding the TFG biomes to minecraft:is_overworld would fix berries and drag in everything
else at the same time, so instead the two features are added directly to TFG's own biome
tag. Same generation step Cobblemon uses (VEGETAL_DECORATION), so density and placement are
unchanged - this only reconnects features that were already configured.
